items.title: Diversification All the Way Down
items.summary_raw: Diversification is not a one-time decision. It should be applied within factors, across factors, and even across time if the goal is to build a more robust multifactor portfolio. That may sound obvious in theory, but in practice many factor portfolios still lean heavily on a single signal, a single style, or a single market regime. Diversification All the Way Down was originally published at Alpha Architect . Please read the Alpha Architect disclosures at your convenience.
items.summary_cn: Alpha Architect 提出“全层级分散化”框架：分散不应是一次性决策，而应贯穿因子内部、因子之间乃至时间维度。文章指出实践中许多多因子组合仍重度依赖单一信号、单一风格或单一市场状态，导致稳健性不足。
items.why_cn: 多因子组合的稳健性往往败在隐性单一暴露上，本文给出系统化的排查与改进思路。

items.title: Less Wrong
items.summary_raw: A fundamental twist on momentum leading to a 1.15 Sharpe strategy
items.summary_cn: Quantitativo 的文章《Less Wrong》对动量因子做了一个基本面维度的改造，号称改造后策略夏普比率达 1.15。核心思路是用基本面信息过滤传统价格动量中的错误信号，降低“错得离谱”的持仓。
items.why_cn: 1.15 夏普的动量改进思路值得复现验证，基本面叠加动量是当下因子增强的热门方向。

items.title: Stock Price Bubble Dissection Requires a look at Fundamentals and Speculation
items.summary_raw: The authors of this research propose a new approach to identifying stock market bubbles by combining traditional valuation data with surveys of investors' expectations. Their findings also challenge the idea that bubbles matter only to financial markets. The authors show that increases in speculative stock valuations can stimulate economic activity, reduce unemployment, and influence monetary policy, even without corresponding improvements in corporate fundamentals. Stock Price Bubble Dissection Requires a look at Fundamentals and Speculation was originally published at Alpha Architect . Please read the Alpha Architect disclosures at your convenience.
items.summary_cn: Alpha Architect 介绍了一项股价泡沫识别研究：将传统估值数据与投资者预期调查相结合来判定泡沫。研究还发现投机性估值上升即便没有基本面支撑，也能刺激经济活动、降低失业率并影响货币政策。
items.why_cn: 泡沫识别叠加情绪面数据，为风险预警与择时模型提供了新的特征构造思路。

items.summary_raw: ## Description This PR fixes Issue #2252 by making FileLock path handling robust to the Current Working Directory (CWD). The previous implementation used `os.path.join`, which could incorrectly anchor absolute paths to the current working directory in certain scenarios. This change replaces that log
items.summary_cn: 微软量化平台 qlib 修复 Issue #2252：FileLock 路径处理原先使用 os.path.join，在某些场景下会把绝对路径错误锚定到当前工作目录，导致文件锁失效。本次 PR 使 FileLock 对 CWD 变化保持稳健。
